summary: The full re-review of candidate c13a4f8e…3ff68 (a059b55) passes on every domain item: extraction fidelity, source coverage, templates, first-class deliverables, no invented source requirements, provenance honesty, operating-logic semantics, the master-prompt mapping (81-block sample), staging, glossary, journeys and permissions. F-DG0-009 is verified fixed and CLOSED_VERIFIED. The verdict is FAIL because the required pre-freeze check fails on the candidate. tools/gates/prefreeze.sh DG0 exits 1 on any fresh checkout, because the round-5 repair committed two Python bytecode caches into the candidate. Running the candidate's own runner-metadata tests rewrites them, which dirties the tree and changes the recomputed candidate ID (F-DG0-010, Medium, mandatory_violation, owner delivery-orchestrator; the fix is trivial). There are no Critical or High findings.
